question: What are the eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW)?
answer:
- TFW is granted to 2% of the approved seats of the program, as per merit. [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]
- A valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only will be accepted. [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]

question: What is the maximum parental annual income allowed under AICTE TFW?
